He tried to balance their concerns with support for building more housing, arguing that many approved projects weren’t being built because interest rates were high, and criticizing the state for eroding local control. The piece also describes District 8 Supervisor Rafael Mandelman challenging the forum’s alarmist framing while saying people who support more housing shouldn’t be assumed to be developer shills.
